protocol: phase3_v1_schema_ceiling_v2: static ceiling of base-primitive induction UNION object-relation schema grammar on arc1_training; reports base-only, schema-only (marginal vocabulary lift), union. Gate: union >= 2x the 5.2% baseline (>=10.4%).
criterion_error: V1 gate >=10.4% premised a modest hand-built grammar would roughly double real-ARC coverage; evidence shows real-ARC transformation space (position-mapping, arrangement, extraction, symmetry) is far broader than any modest grammar.
